learning_outcomes.text: Can perform solid modeling and stress calculations for design purposes.
Provides detailed information about geometric modeling techniques.
Applies modeling and calculation steps in the finite element method.

syllabus_topics: Computer Usage Areas in Mechanical Engineering
Relationship between Geometric Modeling and Design
Concept of Computer-Aided Engineering and Mathematical Modeling
Introduction to Application with Finite Element Method
Problem Solving Steps with Finite Element Method
Structural Static Analysis with Finite Element Method
Strength Calculation with Finite Element Method
bibliography: Mehmet Fırat, Murat Ozsoy,"Makina Mühendisliğinde Bilgisayar Uygulamaları", Sakarya Üniversitesi, 2008.
Y. Nakasone, S. Yoshimoto, T. A. Stolarski, “Engineering Analysis With ANSYS Software”, Elsevier, New Jersey, 2006.
Kunwoo Lee, "Principles of CAD/CAM/CAE Systems", Addison Wesley, 1999.
